mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 98.0) and a slowdown in job growth (PAYEMS below 135000 thousand) indicates an economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0 and PAYEMS < 135000.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS above 400,000 million) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 400,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 900,000 units signals weak demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST below 900.0 thousand units) and a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS below 410,000 million) indicates a broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 900.0 and RSAFS < 410000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% (measured over the last 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5.
